reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5, curriculum and design work delegated by George
factChecks: Independently recomputed all 51 numeric keys (26 lesson questions, 7 recall cards, 18 course-check problems) in packages/curriculum/tests/language-content.test.ts with a separate word counter, hand-listed syllables and explicit arithmetic; all match.

Checked every written answer: each accepted idea, listed alternative and worked example is marked correct by the assessment engine, each choice question has exactly one accepted option, and likely confusions (metaphor for simile, logos for ethos, 'and' for 'so', dramatic for situational irony) are marked wrong.

Checked every quotation against the Project Gutenberg transcription (eBooks 23, 98, 158, 202, 1041, 1279, 1342, 1513, 1522, 1524, 1533, 1745, 2148, 8824, 12242, 23684, 50616) or the Bliss copy of the Gettysburg Address; all are public domain. Counts such as the ten 'it was' clauses in Dickens's opening and Antony's four 'an honourable man' lines were counted in the source text.

Verified the OpenStax Writing Guide with Handbook licence through its CMS metadata and preface on 2026-10-06: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, not CC BY 4.0 as the brief assumed, so it is recorded as reference only. Section mapping (Handbook H3, H4, H6, H9; 9.3) was checked against the downloaded text.

Checked definitions and attributions against Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0, reference only): Toulmin's six elements (The Uses of Argument, 1958), Richards's tenor and vehicle (1936), Booth's unreliable narrator (1961), free indirect speech and Austen, Freytag's five parts. Freytag's placement of the Romeo and Juliet climax and exciting moment was read in the German original.
The scansions and the +/- scene values for Romeo and Juliet are the course's own readings and are presented as such; metrical stress is distinguished from speech stress in the lesson prose.

Inspected the live app at 1440x900 and 390x844 for every lesson (before and after answering) and the placement check; repaired overlapping role labels, a Toulmin layout that measured arrows mid-animation, global SVG styles leaking into the plot arc, colliding phase labels and margin arcs drawn through text. The 1024x768 size was not inspected directly and is covered only by the unrun e2e spec.
Component and engine tests pass (7 and 13). The browser spec apps/web/e2e/language-course.spec.ts was written but not run by the author because of shared fixed ports.
Editorial review is by the authoring agent under delegated authority. There has been no independent human subject review or documented learner trial.
